sibling_label_diagnostic.description: For each row, use labels of other responses in its session only; singleton sessions fall back to global rate. Beta-style shrinkage strength fixed here at 5 for diagnostic scale, not deployment.

code_audit.v91: row endpoint oracle chooses endpoint from realized y; valid only as an outcome-informed complementarity ceiling
code_audit.v102: oracle_group minimizes loss against y[ix] for the same scored group; target row's own label participates in session selection; session_objective groups are all singleton in this dataset

decision.law: Do not interpret V91/V102 oracle headroom as evidence that an equivalent sample-local observable router exists. Treat it only as expert error complementarity unless a label-free separator is independently verified.
decision.next: Prioritize independently motivated observable features (e.g. official productive-math-talk scalars) or genuinely stronger semantic encoders; do not chase oracle gap directly.
